name: FormDeck
title: presentations and pitch decks that agents can draft while you watch
summary: An open presentation app with 67 templates, .pptx and .odp exchange, a presenter view and an MCP server so an agent can draft a deck from your material.
lede: FormDeck is presentations and pitch decks in the form family, an open alternative to PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides. It is built so that Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can draft a whole deck from your material in your chosen template, live, while you watch, then hand it to you for review.
runs_on: macOS 12+, Windows 10+ and Linux, in the browser or as a Tauri desktop app
checks: Drafts a deck from dropped md, pdf, docx, pptx, txt, csv, xlsx, images, gifs or meeting notes, a brief and a template.
Imports and exports .pptx and .potx, and .odp and .otp for LibreOffice Impress.
Presents full screen with twelve transitions, animation builds, pen, highlighter and laser, and a presenter view.
Reviews with comments, replies, mentions, assignees and review status per slide.

facts.dd: nodemode-dev/formdeck; FormDeck is the display name. The app was called formsld through 0.7.0.
Python 3.12 and FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:8197, app on http://localhost:5197, in a Tauri 2 shell

chapters.title: Start from your material
chapters.text: Drop md, pdf, docx, pptx, txt, csv, xlsx, images, gifs or meeting notes, add a brief, pick a template, and get a drafted deck (about 80% there) in seconds, or hand the intake to an agent.

chapters.title: 67 original templates
chapters.text: 67 original templates in 9 categories, each with 21 semantic layouts and a 17-slide sample. Import any .pptx or .potx as a template, and export every template as .pptx.

chapters.title: An agent that builds the deck in the open window
chapters.text: An MCP server with 31 tools over HTTP at /mcp or stdio. Live edits are attributed per agent turn and undone as one step, and contact-sheet rendering and real DOM lint let the agent see and fix its own slides.

features.title: Start from material
features.text: Drop files, add a brief, pick a template.
bullets: md, pdf, docx, pptx, txt, csv, xlsx, images, gifs and meeting notes
A PDF opened or dropped anywhere lands as material
Insert > Slides from PDF Pages adds each page as a slide with its text in the notes

features.title: Templates
bullets: 21 semantic layouts and a 17-slide sample each
Crafter Ideas shows a slide in every layout of its master
Import any .pptx or .potx as a template, export every template as .pptx

features.title: Editing
features.text: A full slide editor with a Slide Master view.
bullets: Editable theme colours and fonts, several masters per deck
Text Art with fill, outline, shadow, glow, reflection and all 40 transforms
Equations in LaTeX or linear format
Merge shapes: union, combine, fragment, intersect, subtract

features.title: Exchange
bullets: PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides via .pptx and .potx import and export
OpenDocument .odp and .otp for LibreOffice Impress
.fdec package, with older .fsld opening
PDF export writes slides as live, embedded text and passes PDF/UA-1 in veraPDF

features.title: Presenting
features.text: Full-screen show and a presenter view.
bullets: Twelve transitions including Morpher and animation builds
Pen, highlighter and laser, Zoom Slider
A live camera in any shape and a presenter view with a separate audience window
Rehearsed timings with an optional Speech Rehearsal

features.title: Review
bullets: Comments with replies, mentions and assignees
Review status per slide and an activity log
Compare a deck with a saved version or another file

features.title: Sharing
features.text: Off by default: FormDeck answers only this computer.
bullets: File > Share Deck gives people on the same network a link to view, comment or edit one deck
They co-edit live in a browser
Removing a link or turning sharing off locks them out
Beyond the local network it needs a relay that you run yourself

features.title: Add-ins
features.text: A Store of add-ins for ribbon commands and task panes.
bullets: Each installed only after you see its permissions, checked against its checksum
Runs in the macro sandbox
FormDeck's own catalog lists three add-ins, and other catalogs can be added
docs/ADDINS.md explains how to publish your own

features.title: Claude Code inside
features.text: A terminal dock with shell tabs and a Claude Code tab.
bullets: Runs your own Claude sign-in with FormDeck's tools
The chat panel's Claude Code assistant uses the same sign-in
Continue a conversation in the terminal or bring one into the chat

features.title: Commands
features.text: About 650 ribbon, menu and shortcut commands in one catalogue.
bullets: Find a Command with Shift+Ctrl or Cmd+P
MCP list_commands and run_command
/api/commands and ./formdeck cli list

features.title: For designers
features.text: Reusable parts and your own fonts.
bullets: Components: save shapes once and update every copy from one
Named text and colour styles
Your own fonts (TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2), embedded in .pptx on request
SVG in as editable shapes

features.title: Languages
bullets: Set in Preferences > Appearance > Language
./formdeck i18n check finds gaps
The 25 translations were made by language models and have not been reviewed by native speakers yet

features.title: Desktop builds
features.text: Each package carries the engine as a frozen sidecar.
bullets: macOS 12+ .app and .dmg
Windows 10+ .msi and setup .exe
Linux .deb, .rpm and .AppImage, and a .flatpak

parity.summary: Of the 104 capabilities the three references document, FormDeck is full on 100 and partial on 4; none is missing outright. It was re-read at 0.29.1 and compared with DeckCraft. PDF editing moved to formpdf, which has its own page.

requirements: Rust, installed with rustup if missing (build_app asks first)
docs.agents: ./formdeck agents install writes .mcp.json, .codex/config.toml and .cursor/mcp.json and installs the skills; the MCP server runs over HTTP at /mcp or stdio via ./formdeck mcp.

topics.title: Manual
topics.text: docs/MANUAL.md is the manual for using the app.

topics.title: Add-ins
topics.text: docs/ADDINS.md explains how to write and publish an add-in.

topics.title: Build a deck with an agent
topics.text: The README shows how to ask an agent to build a deck, and a build-deck command that works without the window.

topics.title: Known gaps
topics.text: The README lists gaps such as sharing beyond the local network needing your own relay, and no OCR for scanned PDFs.
